q: The Model Schedule of Powers (MSoP) issued by Railway Board in 2017/18 was significant because

options.A: It brought about uniformity in schedule of delegation of powers across Zonal Railways
options.B: It delegated all financial powers vested with the Railway Board to General Managers of Zonal Railways
options.C: This MSoP focused on IT integration on Zonal Railways for the first time
options.D: It was based upon the GFR delegation of Govt. of India

e: It brought about uniformity in schedule of delegation of powers across Zonal Railways — that is the right answer. The Model Schedule of Powers (MSoP) issued by the Railway Board in 2017-18 was significant because it brought uniformity in the schedule of delegation of financial and administrative powers across all Zonal Railways, which earlier had their own differing schedules. The model SOP standardized who can sanction what in works, stores and establishment matters across zones. It was a key governance reform making delegation transparent and consistent in Indian Railways.
